title: User-Centered Security in Natural Language Processing

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing feature coefficients to show classifiers' over-reliance on specific profane words, and cross-evaluating cyberbullying models on general toxicity datasets to demonstrate a bias toward blatant aggression rather than complex bullying dynamics.

Conducting cross-domain evaluations by training cyberbullying classifiers on specific social media corpora (e.g., Twitter, Ask.fm, Formspring) and testing them on out-of-domain datasets to measure domain-specific language overfitting and lack of generalization.
